_comment: CC-SNAP-HIGHLIGHT v1 F1/F2 — the ONE source for every highlight threshold. Rust bakes this in with include_str!; the Swift shim mirrors v_min and sat_buckets (the only two it needs, because it applies the V cut and buckets the saturations where the pixels are); scripts/snap-highlight-check.mjs fails the build if they drift. Change a number here, nowhere else.
_calibration: min_paper_px is null ON PURPOSE. CC-SNAP-HIGHLIGHT's review record says it can only be calibrated against the C2 20-photo fixture, which does not exist yet, and inventing it would mean making up the number the constant exists to carry. While it is null the detector scores NOTHING highlighted, which is exactly the v1 fall-back the Intent asks for: fail toward showing every word. Set it, flip calibrated to true, and the detector starts.
